after.workflowCondition: Foundation static guards now watch canonical school/** only, run on main + rebuild/high-school-foundation only, and include a deterministic Foundation CI source-root isolation guard.

measurableWasteRemoved: The shared Foundation workflow no longer triggers from noncanonical highschool/** producer pushes.

fixedDefect.rollbackCriterion: Rollback only if the canonical runtime source root is explicitly changed away from school/** or the source-root isolation guard incorrectly rejects a documented canonical path.
